h7_soundness_argument: Baseline B is a complete scan before any spawn; every run-owned process is created later so its uniqueid is not in B. At L's single-call PID listing every live process is listed; complete L identifies all listed pids; if all identified uids are in B (supervisor itself included) then no run-owned process existed at listing time, so none can be created afterwards by fork descent; the supervisor spawns nothing after L (checked) and its own end is the parent wait. Residuals (named, not claimed): non-descendant creation channels (launchd/XPC/at/cron registrations), producer authenticity, sv19 qualification.
history_checks_per_family: H0 producer ref sha256 == pinned cb828a78 and re-read bytes hash equal
H1 wait doc exact parent-release-wait-v1 keys; role driver(main)/oracle(oracle); waitstatus_to_exitcode(raw_status)==actual_exit; start_fingerprint parses as scheme
H2 main launch doc: launch.item==item and launch.driver typed-equal wait (pid,pgid,start_fingerprint)

H3 stdout capture bytes length/hash equal, ASCII, exactly one LF-terminated line, strict JSON object, supervisor=='owned_supervisor_v19'; ACK canonical = json.dumps(sort_keys,separators(',',':'))+LF; refusal canonical = json.dumps(insertion order,separators)+LF
H4 exit binding: actual_exit==line.exit_code; ACK acknowledged True exit in {0,10,11}; refusal acknowledged False exit in {2,12,13,14}

H5 ACK: receipt/settlement bytes hash equal ACK digests; receipt and settlement canonical bytes_json(sort_keys,indent=1)+LF; settlement.receipt_sha256==ACK.receipt_sha256; versions/config/settlement equal; receipt.supervisor_sha256==cb828a78; receipt history fields are typed prefixes/subsets of the ACK reconciliation history

H6 complete governed history: timing_failed false, history_halted false, history_overflow null, raw_acquisitions empty; exact identity dict schema; event tape [uid,index,status,begin,end,unproved] with refs/counts/variants/first-last consistency; owned registry via/root/edge-proof refs; unproved_history <-> unproved-flag events; baseline uids unique and each has history

H7 closure (key completeness rule): last census record L complete, not aborted, zero incomplete/owned_live/unproved_live/group_live/owned_zombies/refs; ACK ack_census typed-equal L; events inside [L.mono_start,L.mono_complete] have exactly L.pids distinct uids, all baseline, none flagged unproved; no event straddles or begins after the window; every spawn (main child, each helper) provably before L.mono_start

H8 driver binding: exactly one history uid in baseline with pid==wait.pid; all its variants have that pid, same idversion and pgid==wait.pgid; start_fingerprint(pid,uid,idversion)==wait.start_fingerprint; driver pgid==pid (own group); receipt.supervisor_pid==wait.pid when receipt present

H9 main child/helper binding: main_identity <-> owned via child, pgid==pid; each helper report identity <-> pid, pgid==pid; identity-less spawned pids are unknown incarnations closed only by H7+spawn chronology
